integrity: Proof is analytical; finite quadratures and Monte Carlo are supporting checks only. No unperformed independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Planar real SPD matrices, isotropic iid Gaussian oracle, exact arithmetic/line searches; no noisy residual evaluation, higher dimensions, finite-horizon distributional error bound or independent validation. Bibliographic coverage is necessarily incomplete.
title: Exact sample-path rate and Gaussian fluctuations for planar randomized residual line search
